candidate.user_input: Who submits a group business-travel meal bill when separate billing is impracticable?
candidate.reference: If this is not practicable to do due to the group size, then the most senior Team Member present should pay the bill and submit for reimbursement.

evidence.quote: Each Team Member must submit their own receipts for reimbursement, so ensure to separate billing when going to meals with groups of Team Members.
